authors: P. Gilge, A. Kellersmann, S. Kurth, F. Herbst, J. Friedrichs and J. R. Seume
name: luh-surface-roughness-of-real-operationally-used-compressor-blades
notes:
The data set contains three dimensional measured surfaces of real worn  compressor blades from real mid-sized air craft engine high pressure coompressors. Three stages of the compressor are measured. The first stage, the centre stage and the last stage.

Also surface data of a real worn Blisk from a small aircraft engine will be published. We are currently preparing the data.

Further information of the data are given in:
Gilge, P.; Kellersmann, A.; Friedrichs, J.; Seume J.R. (2019): Surface roughness of real operationally used compressor blade and blisk. Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, Part G: Journal of Aerospace Engineering, https://doi.org/10.1177/0954410019843438
title: Surface roughness of real operationally used compressor blade and blisk
